[\"To export, click 存档 (Save) at the bot.en: To export, click Save at the bottom left. To import a different save, close the game, then open [[A0]] and choose Import Save. When upgrading, close the game and select your current install folder to keep [[A1]]. To move to another folder, export a save and import it into the same edition at the new location.

[\"Importing over an existing save creat.en: Importing over an existing save creates a backup. On Android and the web, use Export previous save. On Windows, find it in the save folder under [[A0]].
